description: A React Native boilerplate project designed to provide a solid foundation for building scalable and maintainable mobile applications. The boilerplate promotes best practices, accelerates development, and ensures a consistent architecture across projects.

architecture.description: Emphasizes separation of concerns between the application's domain logic and its user interface [[3]] [[6]] [[9]].

[feature].domain: Core business logic, entities, and use cases
[feature].infrastructure: Adapters for external services (API calls, database access)

developmentEnvironment.description: Provides a streamlined development experience with built-in tools and configurations for code quality, testing, and more [[8]].

codeQuality.eslintPrettier: Pre-configured ESLint and Prettier for code linting and formatting.
codeQuality.husky: Husky integration for pre-commit hooks to enforce code quality checks before committing.
codeQuality.pathAliases: Path aliases for cleaner and more maintainable import statements.
codeQuality.vscodeConfiguration: Recommended VSCode settings and extensions for optimal development.

testing.jest: Configured Jest for unit and integration testing.
testing.reactNativeTestingLibrary: React Native Testing Library for UI component testing.
testing.msw: MSW (Mock Service Worker) setup for mocking API responses during development and testing.
testing.testUtilities: Common test utilities and patterns for writing consistent and effective tests.

themeSystem.description: A flexible and customizable theme system is required to support multiple brands and appearances.

features.darkMode: Dark and light mode variations for each brand theme.
features.themePersistence: Mechanism to persist the user's theme preference (e.g., using AsyncStorage).
features.responsiveDesign: Responsive design utilities for adapting the UI to different screen sizes and orientations.

internationalization.description: The boilerplate should include internationalization (i18n) support for creating multi-lingual applications.

features.languageDetection: Automatic language detection based on the user's device settings.
features.languagePersistence: Persistence of the user's selected language.
features.formattingUtilities: Utilities for number, date, and currency formatting based on the selected locale.
features.translationManagement: A well-defined structure for managing translation files.

stateManagement.description: Redux Toolkit should be used for state management, along with Redux Saga for handling asynchronous actions.

features.reduxToolkit: Redux Toolkit setup for simplified Redux development.
features.reduxSaga: Redux Saga middleware for managing asynchronous operations.
features.reduxPersist: Redux Persist with AsyncStorage to persist the Redux store.
features.apiErrorHandling: Middleware for handling API errors and displaying user-friendly messages.
features.storeEncryption: Encryption of sensitive data in the Redux store for enhanced security.

environmentManagement.description: The boilerplate should support multiple environments (development, staging, production) with easy switching and secure variable handling.

features.environmentSupport: Support for at least three environments: Development, Staging, and Production.
features.runtimeSwitching: Ability to switch between environments at runtime.
features.secureVariables: Secure handling of environment variables, especially API keys and other sensitive information.
features.uiSwitcher: A UI-based environment switcher for development builds to quickly change the active environment.
